author: Brenton Kemp
title: Austin Voth granted release by Rangers
desc: The Rangers have granted right-hander Austin Voth his release.
impact: The Rangers signed Voth to a minors pact earlier this month, and made just one start for Triple-A Round Rock. He has also spent time at Triple-A with the Blue Jays and Twins this season. Voth owns a career 4.84 ERA across 210 big-league appearances, 39 of which have been starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Colton Gordon being viewed as starter by Brewers
desc: The Brewers are reportedly viewing Colton Gordon as a starter.
impact: Gordon was acquired by Milwaukee from the Astros on Wednesday. He has made just one start across four appearances this season, but he made 14 starts last year. He is expected to report to Triple-A Nashville.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: German Marquez starting Sunday versus Royals
desc: Padres right-hander German Marquez will start on Sunday against the Royals.
impact: After the Padres send Michael King to the mound on Friday and Griffin Canning on Saturday, it will be Marquez getting the ball to close out the series on Sunday in Kansas City. The veteran missed two months due to forearm irritation in the first half of the season and owns a 5.18 ERA through nine outings (eight starts) on the campaign.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff (shoulder) 'still working through' injury
desc: Brewers GM Matt Arnold says the team is "still working through" Brandon Woodruff's shoulder injury.
impact: Woodruff was transferred to the 60-day injured list last weekend. There should be further updates on his status later in July.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Griffin Canning starting Saturday versus Royals
desc: Padres right-hander Griffin Canning will start on Saturday against the Royals.
impact: The Padres will tab Michael King to start the second half of the season on Friday, with Canning following up on Saturday. The 30-year-old struggled with a 6.47 ERA in 13 outings (10 starts) in the season's first half, but his 4.50 xFIP at least suggests some positive regression should be had moving forward.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Michael King to start Friday versus Royals
desc: Padres right-hander Michael King will start Friday's series opener against the Royals.
impact: The Friars will tab King to kick of the second half of their season on Friday in Kansas City. The right-hander posted a 3.41 ERA across 19 starts in the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Burrows (elbow) could resume throwing in 7-to-10 days
desc: Mike Burrows could resume throwing in 7-10 days.
impact: Burrows recently landed on the IL with right elbow neuritis. He will be sidelined for at least the next few weeks.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Noah Cameron to start Sunday versus Padres
desc: Royals left-hander Noah Cameron will start on Sunday against the Royals.
impact: The Royals will give the ball to Seth Lugo for the series opener on Friday, and Cameron will follow a TBD starter on Sunday. The southpaw has worked to a 4.89 ERA through 18 starts this season, although his 4.14 xFIP and 4.21 SIERA are more fond of his work.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lance McCullers Jr. could make next outing in majors
desc: Brewers GM Matt Arnold said Lance McCullers Jr.'s next outing could take the form of a major league start.
impact: McCullers was traded to Milwaukee on Wednesday. There should be a further update on him later this week.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Seth Lugo to start Friday versus Padres
desc: Royals right-hander Seth Lugo will start on Friday against the Padres.
impact: Lugo will get the ball to start the second half of the Royals' season coming out of the All-Star break. The veteran took the ball 19 times in the first half, posting a 4.56 ERA while going 3-6 out of the club's rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jhony Brito recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Padres recalled RHP Jhony Brito from Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Brito will likely only be up for a few days with Wandy Peralta placed on the bereavement list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wandy Peralta placed on bereavement list
desc: The Padres placed LHP Wandy Peralta on the bereavement list.
impact: Peralta will be away from the Padres for at least a few days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Harrison (forearm) trending in right direction
desc: Brewers GM Matt Arnold said he's receiving positive reports from Kyle Harrison.
impact: Harrison was placed on the injured list last weekend with forearm tightness. He could have a chance to return in late July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy Troy (shoulder) placed on IL
desc: The Diamondbacks placed Tommy Troy on the 10-day IL with a sprained right AC joint.
impact: Troy suffered the injury last weekend right before the All-Star break. He'll be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Pavin Smith outrighted by Diamondbacks
desc: Pavin Smith cleared waivers and was outrighted to Triple-A Reno.
impact: Smith will remain in the Diamondbacks organization.
